findings.highlight: You do not have the right to criticize.
findings.evidenceJa: 腑抜けなどと、貴方に言う資格はない
findings.governingReading: 腑抜けなどと means “calling her a coward” (or similar); Saber objects to Archer branding Rider a coward, not to his having any criticism whatsoever.
findings.explanation: Saber’s rebuttal drops the specific charge she is answering.

findings.highlight: I don't know what crawled up your ass
findings.evidenceJa: 何が癇に障ったかは知らんが
findings.governingReading: 何が癇に障ったかは知らんが asks what offended or irritated Saber; it is sardonic but contains no bodily profanity.
findings.explanation: Archer’s cool challenge is recast in a much cruder register.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka and Archer also step back
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂もアーチャーを後ろに下げて
findings.governingReading: Rin has Archer move back and restarts the discussion after Saber withdraws.
findings.explanation: Rin directing Archer back becomes both of them stepping back, reducing her explicit role in ending the confrontation.

findings.highlight: That woman is not someone to willingly suffer others
findings.evidenceJa: あの女は人の下につく者ではない
findings.governingReading: Archer theorizes that Caster would immediately remove the Master as an obstacle or authority and use them for her convenience. His account is subsequently reconsidered in favor of deception.
findings.explanation: Archer's prediction that Caster would remove her Master's authority at the outset becomes an abstract rejection of having a Master. Her manipulation of that person remains explicit.

findings.highlight: Originally, a Servant cannot do anything to a Master.
findings.evidenceJa: 本来、サーヴァントはマスターには手出しができない
findings.governingReading: 手出しができない in this explanation means a Servant cannot lay hands on or harm their Master, in light of the risk of losing their own existence; it does not preclude every interaction.
findings.explanation: A restriction on harming a Master is broadened into a ban on doing anything to one.

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターのマスターが間の抜けた人間、という可能性
findings.governingReading: 間の抜けた人間 describes a foolishly naive or gullible person in this context; Archer is needling Shirou for being an easy mark, not diagnosing stupidity.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s gullible good nature is reduced to low intelligence.

findings.highlight: We'll both go home and think about it
findings.evidenceJa: 各自、家に帰って考えること
findings.governingReading: 各自、家に帰って考えること directs each person to go home and think; the group includes Rin, Archer, Shirou, and Saber.
findings.explanation: Rin assigns the planning task to only two people instead of everyone present.

findings.highlight: I'll acknowledge you as a proper Master just for today
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとだけだけど、貴方をマスターだって認めてあげたから
findings.governingReading: ちょっとだけだけど…認めてあげたから reports that she has already acknowledged Shirou as a Master, albeit only a little.
findings.explanation: Rin’s small, completed concession becomes a promise that lasts only for today.
